mission: Mission 13 — Forensic Audit of Mission 12 Discrepancies

discrepancies.root_cause: The factorial table measured actual end-to-end sequence frame wall-clock times across 1,213 frames, which extracted two 448px crops per frame (2 x 27.8 ms = 55.6 ms crop inference) added to base 640px inference (38.0 ms), proposal generation (5.4 ms), PIL crop slicing (2.4 ms), and NMS merging (1.0 ms), totalling ~102.4 ms. In contrast, the 51.60 ms edge benchmark reported an idealized target model assuming a single crop (K=1) without serial forward pass overhead, and its stages table mistakenly omitted the second crop forward pass and summed overlapping pipeline stages.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Establish a single authoritative non-overlapping measurement protocol where base inference, proposal generation, crop extraction, crop forward passes (K x single crop ms), coordinate restoration, NMS merging, and online tracking are recorded with rigorous start/stop boundaries and exact crop counts.

discrepancies.root_cause: The reported 92.7% oracle figure was calculated using a geometric spatial acuity heuristic (targets with area >= 64 px^2 and width/height >= 8 px, which would reach detectable acuity >= 16 px under 2x optical magnification), rather than executing actual forward passes on ground-truth crops.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Properly classify the 92.7% metric as theoretical geometric crop recoverability rather than detector-verified oracle inference, and explicitly document that classification capacity on heavily occluded or severely blurred sub-16px targets remains bounded.

discrepancies.root_cause: Verified empirically from raw prediction artifacts. At 640x384 downsampling, sub-16px objects become sub-8px on the detector input, smaller than the stride-8 P3 grid cells, producing zero anchor activations >= 0.20 confidence. At 832px (stride-8 cells ~1.1x object size), IoU with tiny 12-14px GT boxes fails to satisfy the strict IoU >= 0.50 threshold, resulting in 0 True Positives and 1,282 False Negatives.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Confirm that zero baseline ultra-small recall is mathematically and empirically genuine for both YOLO640 and YOLO832 on the locked test cohort under canonical COCO evaluation criteria.

discrepancies.category: Config I vs Config J Metric and Latency Equivalence
discrepancies.root_cause: Config I and Config J executed the identical ProposalFusionController and detection pipeline; Config J additionally evaluated Stream 2 (AdverseWeatherByteTracker) on the output stream. Stream 1 detection metrics are therefore bit-for-bit identical. The 7.41 ms latency difference was due to M1 CPU thread scheduling and thermal dispatch variance across sequential execution passes.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Clearly denote that Config J is Config I augmented with the decoupled Stream 2 tracking stream, and report both within the same standardized timing framework.

discrepancies.category: Unit Test Coverage Gaps in Mission 12
discrepancies.root_cause: The 9 unit tests covered component math (differencing, flow, salience, deduplication, budget clamping), but lacked integration testing for end-to-end crop coordinate round-tripping with real YOLO forward passes, sequence-level temporal continuity across frames, proposal displacement checks, and edge cases (empty proposal frames, single-crop requests).
discrepancies.reconciliation: Implement a dedicated Mission 13 test suite (tests/test_mission13_priority_allocation.py) covering candidate representation schema, priority ranking, detector-first preservation, spatial coverage novelty, independent candidate admission, and end-to-end integration.
